name: browser-automation-studio.navigate-intent
purpose: Start or resume one bounded vision-navigation, read its status once with an optional server-side wait, classify it, and turn a completed navigation's recorded steps into a typed V2 candidate flow.

session.description: Existing playwright-driver browser session id; required unless navigation_id resumes an earlier navigation.

prompt.description: Natural-language navigation instruction; required when starting, ignored when resuming by navigation_id.

max_steps.description: Step budget, 1..25 (the CLI allows up to 100; this program caps lower).

model.description: Vision model identifier; required when starting (the binding has no default and a caller must not hardcode a slug), ignored when resuming.

navigation_id.description: Resume: read the status of this navigation instead of starting a new one.

wait_millis.description: Server-side bounded wait (0..300000) for a terminal status before the single read returns; the wait is the vision-navigation status binding's own, not a client loop.

assumptions: browser-automation-studio is running and the session id names a live browser session
vision-navigation status accepts wait_millis and blocks server-side up to that long; without it a read right after start usually says navigating and the caller resumes with navigation_id
the navigator's credit policy may refuse the start; that is reported refused, not retried
an unknown session id surfaces as `driver error: status 404` from the driver and is classified session_not_found; an unknown navigation_id on resume is classified session_not_found
invariants: at most one navigation is started; a resume starts none; no abort, no retry
status is read exactly once; the wait is server-side, there is no client polling loop
a candidate flow is emitted only from a completed navigation with recorded steps, in the V2 shape nodes[].action.type plus edges, ending in an assertion
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.status: driver status at the single read: idle|navigating|awaiting_human|completed|failed|aborted|max_steps_reached|loop_detected
signals.outcome: reached | human_pause | budget | in_progress | failed | unknown
signals.candidate_flow: V2 flow {nodes[{id, action{type, <params>}}], edges[{source,target,type}]} rebuilt from the navigation's recorded steps; absent unless the navigation completed with replayable steps

fixtures.note: Valid bounded exercise fixture added after admission-only fixtures left the contract unexercised.
